verdict_reason: The heading change in REQ-001 matches groups.js and the template, but the changed 003-A scenario disagrees with its own requirement and leaves out the Latin-name fallback the table uses.

todos.issue: The changed SCN-COMMODITY-DETAILS-003-A says each row lists 'its code and the common names of the species chosen under it', but REQ-COMMODITY-DETAILS-003 (line 29) still says a row names only the commodity code, so requirement and scenario disagree. And 'common names' understates the code: selected-rows.js builds the name with speciesName (species-name.js: entry.commonName ?? entry.speciesLatinName), so a species MDM holds without a common name (the fixture has several, e.g. 'Casuariiformes, Rheiformes, Struthioniformes' with commonName null) shows its Latin name.
todos.fix: Must: REQ-COMMODITY-DETAILS-003 and SCN-COMMODITY-DETAILS-003-A/C describe the same row content, and that description matches the page: code plus each chosen species' common name, or its Latin name where it has none. One way: add the name column to the requirement sentence and say 'the common name of each species chosen under it, or its scientific name where it has none' in 003-A (and 'named by the species' in 003-C the same way).
